headline: Executive order directs federal agencies to build a regional plan on migration in North and Central America and on processing asylum seekers at the US border.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order directs the federal government to create a broad plan with countries in North and Central America. The plan is meant to address the reasons people leave their home countries and to manage migration across the region. It also calls for safe and orderly processing of people seeking asylum at the US border. No summary was provided, so specific actions, programs, and deadlines are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: People seeking asylum at the US border
who_it_affects.how: The order addresses how their asylum requests are processed when they arrive at the border.
The order aims to address the reasons people leave their countries and to manage migration through the region.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that handle immigration and foreign affairs
who_it_affects.how: They are directed to develop and carry out the regional plan and border processing approach.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 2, 2021; specific deadlines are not stated in the title.
